label: nothing
what: The record does not substantiate two or more people jointly preparing something the mayor was not told about. Bakery lights were mentioned as hearsay, but the baker denied knowing of a special occasion and said the work was ordinary market bread. Later talk of a bridge or port change was repeatedly described as a vague, unverified rumor; the baker and neighbour explicitly said no change or proposal was verified. No knowing helper or concealed preparation is established.
